principle: Backend Ops and GlacierEQ are scoped peer planes in a polycentric estate. Backend Ops owns connector/control/cognitive capability state within its domain; GlacierEQ maintains mission/substantive operational projections and working state within its domain; source-bearing case repositories, Operator firsthand records, provider-native systems, evidence artifacts, and other qualified peers retain proposition-specific authority for the facts and bytes they actually bear. No plane becomes universal truth by convenience or topology.

capability_repository_fabric.discovery_authority: supabase-backend-ops Repo Atlas latest observed snapshot, derived from GitHub provider state
capability_repository_fabric.registry_policy: Link repositories and observed SHAs; do not copy repository source into Supabase or promote discovery candidates into runtime authority without evidence.

source_authority.operator_firsthand: Operator-authored firsthand observations, testimony, intent, objectives, and corrections within their scope
source_authority.case_repositories: versioned source-bound case graphs, allegations, legal propositions, provenance and case-specific contracts within their scope
source_authority.github: code, schemas, migrations, repository heads, versioned behavioral contracts
source_authority.provider_native_systems: provider execution state, message/send/delivery receipts, source bytes
source_authority.evidence_artifacts: native source bytes and provenance-bound extracted propositions within their evidentiary scope
source_authority.supabase_backend_ops: live scoped capability/control/runtime projection and repository linkage
source_authority.supabase_glaciereq: live scoped mission/runtime projection and interoperable substantive working state

cross_plane_rules: Mission objects may request capabilities but do not own connector implementations.
Control-plane execution may carry bounded provenance-bearing mission projections but must not promote them into substantive truth.

GlacierEQ mission tables may operationalize case facts, propositions, contradictions, evidence bindings, and actions, but projection or storage location does not displace the proposition-specific authority of Operator firsthand records, source-bound case repositories, provider-native records, or native evidence artifacts.
Global behavioral contracts within GlacierEQ-controlled infrastructure belong in Backend Ops; case-scoped strategy and instructions remain mission data.
Capability repositories remain GitHub source authority; Backend Ops stores discovery, classification, active SHA bindings, relationships, runtime status and receipts.
A discovered capability repository is not automatically an active runtime implementation; confirmation requires source/runtime evidence.
Mutable inventory counts and health state are runtime observations, not versioned topology authority.
Existing GlacierEQ global instruction rows are preserved as legacy provenance projections and are not deleted during cutover.
No provider-native source is replaced by a Supabase projection.
No source-bearing case repository is replaced by a Supabase projection merely because the projection is operationally convenient.

No hidden platform system or developer prompt is claimed, reconstructed, or stored as GlacierEQ-controlled authority; only Operator-controlled behavioral artifacts and explicit source references belong in the control plane.
